Arcadia Biosciences is at the forefront of agricultural biotechnology, focusing on improving crop yield and resilience. They specialize in developing sustainable agricultural solutions, including enhanced crop varieties and optimized nutritional profiles. [Immuno Concepts](https://immunoconcepts.com/)


Immuno Concepts remains a key player in the diagnostics space, offering innovative tests for autoimmune diseases. Their state-of-the-art reagents and diagnostic tools, including their proprietary autoimmune testing panels, empower healthcare providers with accurate and reliable disease detection, improving patient care outcomes. In recent years, they have expanded their diagnostic portfolio to include advanced multiplex testing, enabling simultaneous detection of multiple biomarkers and improving diagnostic efficiency. Their role in pharmaceutical companies in Sacramento has strengthened local diagnostic capabilities.

[NeuroVision Imaging](https://neurovision.com/)


NeuroVision Imaging’s advanced retinal imaging technology continues to revolutionize early disease detection. By utilizing non-invasive retinal autofluorescence, they contribute to better outcomes in retinal disease monitoring and vision preservation. Their technology is now being explored for applications in neurodegenerative diseases such as Alzheimer’s. In partnership with leading research institutions, NeuroVision has initiated clinical trials to validate its efficacy in early detection. Their presence adds to the dynamic ecosystem of biotech Sacramento innovation.

[Certis Biologicals](https://www.certisbio.com/)


Certis Biologicals is a leader in biopesticides and agricultural biotechnology. They develop environmentally friendly pest control solutions that support sustainable farming practices. Their research emphasizes microbial-based products that protect crops without harming beneficial insects or ecosystems, aligning with global efforts to reduce chemical pesticide use. Certis’ partnerships with biotech companies Sacramento underscore their impact on sustainable agriculture.

[‍ Infinant Health (formerly Evolve Biosystems)](https://www.infinanthealth.com/)


Infinant Health, formerly known as **Evolve Biosystems** , specializes in gut microbiome science and is a leader in probiotic research. The company focuses on improving infant health through microbiome-based interventions. Their flagship product, **Evivo®** , is a probiotic designed to restore beneficial bacteria in infants' guts, supporting early immune development and overall health.


As of 2026, Infinant Health is expanding its research into microbiome applications for adult populations, including treatments for **metabolic and autoimmune disorders** . This expansion highlights the growing impact of **pharmaceutical companies in Sacramento** in the field of microbiome science, further establishing the region as a leader in innovative healthcare solutions.

Orca Bio is a clinical-stage biotechnology company specializing in precision cell therapies for cancer and other serious diseases. In 2026, Orca Bio is advancing its clinical trials and expanding its manufacturing capabilities in Sacramento, reinforcing the city's reputation as a hub for advanced biotech research and development.
